source_policy: All records correspond to verified PubMed records. Evidence text is curator-written from the PubMed abstract and explicitly not verbatim.
overlap_policy: PMIDs are unique within this extension and disjoint from the original benchmark, Extension 01, and External Validation V2.

records.title: Peppermint oil (Mintoil) in the treatment of irritable bowel syndrome: a prospective double blind placebo-controlled randomized trial
records.evidence_text: Peppermint oil produced a substantially greater reduction in overall IBS symptom scores than placebo after four weeks.

records.title: Ginger for nausea and vomiting in pregnancy: randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled trial
records.evidence_text: Ginger reduced nausea severity and vomiting episodes significantly more than placebo during pregnancy.

records.title: Safety and efficacy of Curcuma longa extract in the treatment of painful knee osteoarthritis: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
records.evidence_text: Curcuma longa extract significantly improved pain and knee function compared with placebo.

records.title: Efficacy and tolerability of Boswellia serrata extract in treatment of osteoarthritis of knee--a randomized double blind placebo controlled trial
records.evidence_text: Boswellia serrata extract significantly reduced knee pain and improved flexion and walking distance versus placebo.

records.title: Lipid-lowering effects of time-released garlic powder tablets in double-blinded placebo-controlled randomized study
records.evidence_text: Time-released garlic significantly lowered total and LDL cholesterol and increased HDL compared with placebo.

records.title: Ginger (Zingiber officinale) reduces acute chemotherapy-induced nausea: a URCC CCOP study of 576 patients
records.evidence_text: Several ginger doses significantly reduced acute nausea severity compared with placebo on the first chemotherapy day.

records.title: Peppermint Oil Treatment for Irritable Bowel Syndrome: A Randomized Placebo-Controlled Trial
records.evidence_text: Peppermint oil and placebo improved IBS symptoms, but the between-group difference was not statistically significant.

records.title: Garlic powder and plasma lipids and lipoproteins: a multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled trial
records.evidence_text: There were no significant differences in lipid or lipoprotein changes between garlic and placebo.

records.title: Effect of garlic (Allium sativum) powder tablets on serum lipids, blood pressure and arterial stiffness in normo-lipidaemic volunteers: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial
records.indication: lipids and blood pressure in normolipidemic adults
records.evidence_text: No significant differences between garlic and placebo were detected for any primary or secondary outcome.

records.title: Effect of raw garlic vs commercial garlic supplements on plasma lipid concentrations in adults with moderate hypercholesterolemia: a randomized clinical trial
records.evidence_text: Raw garlic and two garlic supplements produced no statistically significant effect on LDL cholesterol compared with placebo.

records.title: A Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial of Panax Ginseng for Cancer-Related Fatigue in Patients With Advanced Cancer
records.evidence_text: Fatigue improved in both groups, but Panax ginseng was not significantly superior to placebo after four weeks.

records.title: Rhodiola rosea for mental and physical fatigue in nursing students: a randomized controlled trial
records.evidence_text: Rhodiola performed significantly worse than placebo on two fatigue measures after 42 days.

records.title: Peppermint Oil and Sweets in Pediatric Irritable Bowel Syndrome and Functional Abdominal Pain: A Randomized Trial
records.indication: pediatric IBS or functional abdominal pain
records.evidence_text: Neither peppermint oil nor peppermint sweets were superior to placebo for pediatric IBS or functional abdominal pain.

records.title: Garlic supplementation and serum cholesterol: a meta-analysis
records.evidence_text: The meta-analysis found no beneficial effect of garlic on total cholesterol, LDL, triglycerides, or HDL compared with placebo.

records.title: On the effect of garlic on plasma lipids and lipoproteins in mild hypercholesterolaemia
records.evidence_text: The trial found no demonstrable effect of garlic on plasma lipids, lipoproteins, or blood pressure compared with placebo.

records.title: Curcuminoid treatment for knee osteoarthritis: a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial
records.evidence_text: Curcuminoids improved pain and physical function versus placebo, but stiffness did not improve significantly.

records.title: Cranberry juice for the prevention of recurrences of urinary tract infections in children: a randomized placebo-controlled trial
records.indication: recurrent urinary tract infection in children
records.evidence_text: Cranberry did not significantly reduce the proportion with recurrent UTI, but reduced UTI incidence density and antibiotic days.

records.title: Effects of garlic on dyslipidemia in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus
records.evidence_text: Garlic improved total cholesterol, LDL and HDL versus placebo, while triglycerides showed no significant between-group benefit.

records.title: The Effect of a Standardized Ginger Extract on Chemotherapy-Induced Nausea-Related Quality of Life in Patients Undergoing Moderately or Highly Emetogenic Chemotherapy: A Double Blind, Randomized, Placebo Controlled Trial
records.evidence_text: Ginger improved several quality-of-life outcomes in cycles one and three, but showed no significant benefit in cycle two.

records.title: Efficacy of ginger on intraoperative and postoperative nausea and vomiting in elective cesarean section patients
records.indication: perioperative nausea and vomiting during cesarean section
records.evidence_text: Ginger reduced the number of intraoperative nausea episodes, while nausea incidence and vomiting outcomes were not significantly different.
